name: Dalaran's Intentions
summary: Dalar Dawnweaver sends Shadow Priest Allister a warning from Silverpine Forest. A pendant bound for the Kirin Tor in Ambermill reveals their plan to awaken a dormant ley energy node beneath the town, and the Forsaken at the Sepulcher prepare to answer.

sections.title: A Dormant Spark
sections.body: Dalar Dawnweaver studies a rune-inscribed pendant from a Dalaran supply crate and recalls an old Kirin Tor survey. Ambermill was chosen for a reason: the quiet village sits atop a dormant ley energy node. Dalar realizes the wizards intend to tap it. Awakening such a nexus takes immense magical reserves, and the enchanted pendants the wizards wear are key to channeling and catalyzing its power.

sections.title: The Threat to Silverpine
sections.body: The Forsaken cannot tolerate a fortified, power-fueled Kirin Tor outpost threatening the southern approaches to the Sepulcher and Tirisfal Glades. Whatever ritual the magi prepare, raw ley energy would give Dalaran an enormous strategic advantage in Lordaeron. Dalar urgently sends word to Shadow Priest Allister, asking him to devise a way to stall the wizards before their ritual is complete.

faq.q: What is the Kirin Tor trying to do in Ambermill?
aliases: what are dalaran wizards doing in silverpine
faq.answer: The wizards of Dalaran aim to awaken the dormant ley energy node beneath Ambermill. Its power would let them establish a permanent presence and pursue their wider plans in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Why does Dalar send you to Shadow Priest Allister?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister holds authority over Forsaken tactics and countermeasures against Dalaran. Dalar Dawnweaver brings arcane insight and research, while Allister directs the response from the Sepulcher.

faq.q: How do the wizards' pendants tie into their plans?
faq.answer: The dormant ley node demands immense reserves of power to awaken. The wizards' enchanted pendants act as conduits and reservoirs for that magic, so taking them away would hinder the node's activation.

angles.text: As an Undead, you know Dalaran's presence deep in Silverpine threatens Forsaken borders. Stopping the ley line ritual protects the roads between Tirisfal and the southern borders.

As a Mage, you can recognize the Kirin Tor's method. Tapping dormant ley lines gives them an efficient way to establish a powerful arcane beachhead without hauling massive power sources through the wilderness.

As a Priest, you know Shadow Priest Allister directs the Forsaken defense at the Sepulcher. He joins cold military pragmatism with the dark teachings of the Forsaken priesthood to purge living threats.
